construction: Defined in tools/corpus/make_toy_instances.m and written by MOSEK (mosekopt write, JTASK) from prob.a, c, blc, buc, blx, bux, f, g, accs; read back by mosekopt read, bit-for-bit equal to the written arrays.
derivation: Primal exponential cone on (x0, x1, x2): x0 >= x1 exp(x2 / x1), x1 > 0. With x1 = 1 and x2 = 1 fixed, x0 >= exp(1), so the minimum is e, attained only at x0 = e; objective e.
